## Description

Decide between Azure SQL read replica with masked/aggregated views and a separate de-identified warehouse; define the metric model for reports and how drill-down to authorised detail works.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ADR-008 records the choice, cost and PHI controls.
- [ ] **AC2.** Report queries never run against tables with unmasked PHI for non-clinical roles.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
